package postgres

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestOpenPracticePathPlanningBindingRequiresFrozenPositionTargetsAndReference(t *testing.T) {
	revision := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	targets := []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.interfaces", Version: "v1"}}
	current := []domain.LearningPathItem{{ReferenceType: "practice", ReferenceID: revision, Position: 2, Status: domain.LearningPathItemInProgress, Targets: targets}}
	desired := []domain.LearningPathItem{{ReferenceType: "practice", ReferenceID: revision, Position: 2, Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, Targets: append([]domain.LearningTargetRef(nil), targets...)}}
	if !openPracticePathPlanningBindingPreserved(current, desired, revision, 2, targets, true) {
		t.Fatal("exact planner reconciliation must preserve the open binding")
	}
	desired[0].Position = 1
	if openPracticePathPlanningBindingPreserved(current, desired, revision, 2, targets, true) {
		t.Fatal("reordered Practice item must conflict")
	}
	desired[0].Position = 2
	desired[0].Targets[0].Version = "v2"
	if openPracticePathPlanningBindingPreserved(current, desired, revision, 2, targets, true) {
		t.Fatal("target drift must conflict")
	}
	desired = nil
	if openPracticePathPlanningBindingPreserved(current, desired, revision, 2, targets, true) {
		t.Fatal("removed Practice item must conflict")
	}
	desired = []domain.LearningPathItem{{ReferenceType: "practice", ReferenceID: revision, Position: 2, Status: domain.LearningPathItemPlanned, Targets: targets}}
	if openPracticePathPlanningBindingPreserved(current, desired, revision, 2, targets, false) {
		t.Fatal("legacy replacement must reject status regression")
	}
}
